_note: This file exists to prove one specific thing from SPEC 11.4: a refinement lands AFTER
the turn ends, so the turn persists the JOB, not just the message text. turn-0002
below carries job_id 7f3a and no refined text of its own; the refined answer is
rebuilt on load from jobs.json. Reload the page and the 34-second answer is still
there, still stacked under the provisional, still not overwriting it.
There is deliberately no retrieval-metadata field here. The '20 -> 5 chunks' line in
the SPEC 11.2 mockup is derived at render time from config (index.search.ann_k /
rerank_top_n) and the cited chunk ids, so no schema change was needed for chrome.
turn-0001 is the SPEC 10 D6 question the index genuinely answers (grounded: true, no
job). turn-0002 is the one it genuinely cannot (grounded: false -> escalated).

turns.question: When did the van arrive at the loading door?
turns.provisional_answer: A white panel van reverses toward the loading door starting at 21:11:07 and is stopped across the fire door bay by 21:11:11. It has not moved again through 21:11:52.

turns.question: Was the van's rear door open when it backed up?
turns.provisional_answer: A white panel van reversed toward the loading door around 21:11. The caption doesn't record whether its rear door was open.
